art_direction.style: Scandinavian storybook illustration; watercolor and gouache on textured paper; fine ink linework; soft ambient light; muted natural colors; medium detail
art_direction.palette: Pine greens, birch whites, oak browns, soot blacks, wool greys, stone neutrals, ice blues
art_direction.lighting: Ambient first; warm hearth light or diffuse arctic daylight
art_direction.avoid: photorealism, 3D render, neon colors, hyper-detail, extreme contrast, glossy plastic, modern materials

toys.category_style: Card format with rustic wooden title banner at top displaying the toy name, misty Nordic pine forest background, storybook illustration feel, the toy centered and prominent

assets.name: Wool-Warden Effigy
assets.description: The Shape: Simple humanoid form, about 6 inches tall. Round head, stubby arms, no legs—a swaddled figure. The Material: Cream-colored wool felt, soft but dense. Visible fiber texture. The Face: Two dark stitched dots for eyes, a gentle curved line for mouth. Watching, not staring. The Stuffing: Firmly packed wool_fiber inside—squeezable but holds its shape. The Feel: Warm even when cold. Soft enough for a sleeping child's grip. The Wear: Meant to be loved hard. Edges soften with use, not unravel.

assets.name: Rune-Singer Blocks
assets.description: The Blocks: Oak cubes, honey-gold with tight grain. Heavier than they look. The Runes: Each face carved with a single Elder Futhark rune. Orange paint fills the grooves—the symbols pop against the wood. The Set: 24 blocks for the full Elder Futhark, plus 6 blanks for building. The Finish: Resin seal gives a satin sheen. The runes are protected but tactile—small fingers trace them naturally. The Stack: These are building blocks first, alphabet second. Towers and walls, then words. The Sound: Solid oak clicks when stacked. Satisfying clatter when they fall.

assets.name: Borealis Birds
assets.description: Mother Swan: Graceful arched neck, wings suggested by carved ridges. White base with dramatic orange and blue aurora streaks across the back and wings. The Cygnets: Three small teardrops with upturned heads. Mostly white with subtle aurora hints—they haven't earned their full colors yet. The Colors: White snow-base, orange fire-streaks, blue shimmer at the edges. The aurora captured in paint. The Finish: Glossy from resin_seal. Waterproof and bath-ready. In Water: They float upright, pine's buoyancy keeping them stable. The colors dance on the water's surface. The Set: Mother and three cygnets. They cluster together naturally when floating.

assets.name: Rag Doll
assets.description: The Shape: Simple humanoid form, about 8 inches tall. Arms and legs extend from a single body piece—no separate limbs. The Fabric: Natural linen—pale cream with subtle texture. Cool to the touch. The Face: Two embroidered dots for eyes, a gentle curved smile. Simple and timeless. The Hair: Loose tow fibers stitched to the head—straw-gold, slightly wild. The Stuffing: Tow chaff inside—soft but with body. She bends but holds her shape. The Feel: Cool linen exterior, giving softness within. Lighter than wool dolls.

assets.name: Sun-Whirler
assets.description: The Disc: Heavy oak circle, 4 inches diameter. Decorative grooves radiate from center like sun rays, stained orange with rowan. The Cord: Natural linen loop, about 2 feet total. Twisted tight for strength. The Holes: Two small holes near center, tallow-smoothed to prevent cord wear. The Motion: Pull-release rhythm makes the disc spin and reverse. At speed, it blurs into a golden sun. The Sound: A rising hum that changes pitch with speed—the voice of the returning light. The Feel: Satisfying tension in the cord, gyroscopic pull from the spinning disc.

assets.name: Antler Clacker
assets.description: The Frame: Natural antler fork, cream-white with subtle grain. Handle is the main beam, two tines form the arms. The Discs: Four bone circles, slightly dished, strung in pairs. Polished smooth from handling. The Stringing: Sinew loops connect discs to antler arms, sealed with amber resin. The Sound: Sharp clatter of bone-on-bone, deeper thunk when discs hit antler. Rhythmic when shaken properly. The Motion: Grip handle, shake side-to-side. The discs swing and strike in syncopated rhythm. The Feel: Light but solid. The antler handle is warm and smooth.

assets.name: Fortune's Bones
assets.description: The Dice: Six bone cubes, cream-white with dark rune numerals. Slightly irregular—hand-carved, not factory-perfect. The Cup: Birch cylinder, open at top, palm-sized. Pale bark exterior, smooth interior. The Pegs: Ten small bone pins, pointed at one end. Used to track scores in soft wood or earth. The Pouch: Birch bark folded into a drawstring bag, sinew closure. Everything fits inside. The Sound: Sharp rattle of bone on wood when shaking. Satisfying clatter when dice spill. The Ritual: Shake the cup. Slam it down. Lift to reveal fate.

assets.name: Tale-Weaver's Set
assets.description: The Blade: Pale ash sword, about 20 inches. Viking-style profile with gentle taper. Fuller groove carved down the flat. Rounded edges—safe but authentic. The Handle: Leather-wrapped grip, crossguard carved from the same ash blank. Pommel is a simple dome. The Scabbard: Birch core wrapped in brown leather. Brass-colored birch bark accent at throat. The Carry: Leather belt loop and strap. Hangs at the hip, saga-ready. The Draw: Smooth slide with a satisfying 'shick' as blade clears scabbard. The Weight: Light enough for a child, substantial enough to feel heroic.

assets.name: Jarl's Shield-Plaque
assets.description: The Shape: Round shield form, about 12 inches diameter. Oak backing, leather face. The Color: Deep royal purple—'Rauðblár'—velvety matte from the distemper. The color of kings. The Design: Simple rune or beast motif in natural leather, revealed by masking before painting. The Edge: Leather wraps around to the back, secured with visible sinew stitching. The Finish: Resin seal gives subtle sheen without destroying the velvety purple. The Hanging: Sinew loop at back. Meant to catch firelight on a dark winter wall.

assets.name: Wool-Walker Bunny
assets.description: The Shape: Classic bunny form, about 10 inches tall. Long upright ears, round body, stubby limbs. The Ears: The signature feature—bone toggles inside let them pose. Stand them up, fold them down, flop them sideways. The Face: Polished bone eyes with carved pupils. Bone button nose. Embroidered whiskers and mouth. The Body: Cream or grey wool_fabric, firmly stuffed. Huggable but holds its shape. The Feel: Warm wool exterior, dense stuffing. The ears have satisfying resistance when posed. The Wear: Built for years of love. Seams are reinforced, tallow-treated for durability.

assets.name: Linen Lass
assets.description: The Shape: Classic rag doll form, about 12 inches. Round head, simple body, poseable arms. The Arms: Bone toggles at shoulders allow full rotation. She can wave, hug, or rest hands in her lap. The Face: Polished bone eyes catch firelight. Embroidered nose and smile. Warm expression. The Hair: Tow fiber stitched to scalp—straw gold, long enough to braid. The Dress: Simple linen shift, integral to body. Bone buttons down the front. The Feel: Cool linen exterior, soft tow stuffing. Arms move smoothly on their bone joints.

assets.name: Jingle Tambourine
assets.description: The Frame: Ash ring, about 8 inches diameter. Four slots hold paired bone jingles. The Head: Taut leather drum skin, pale and translucent. Responds to tap or slap. The Jingles: Four pairs of bone buttons on sinew—they clatter against each other and the frame when shaken. The Grip: Leather strap on back for secure one-handed hold. The Sound: Tap the head for a soft thump. Shake for bright bone-clatter. Combine both for rhythm. The Feel: Light and responsive. Natural to shake, slap, or tap.

assets.name: Solstice Storm-Drum
assets.description: The Frame: Birch hoop, about 14 inches diameter. Pale wood with visible grain. The Head: Raw hide stretched taut—translucent, amber-toned. You can see shadows through it. The Lacing: Sinew criss-crosses underneath, creating the signature pattern. Linen cord handle through the center. The Mallet: Antler head wrapped in tow padding on an ash stick. Produces a deep, resonant boom. The Sound: Deep thunder-boom that sustains and rolls. Strikes the chest as much as the ears. The Hold: Grip the cord handle, drum face outward. Strike and let the sound flow through you.

assets.name: Ash Hobbyhorse
assets.description: The Head: Carved ash, stylized horse profile with open mouth. Light grey wood with visible grain. The Eyes: Polished bone discs set in sockets—they catch the light with life. The Mane: Shaggy wool_fiber loops along the crest—wild and flowing. The Bridle: Leather straps with bone button cheek pieces. Reins loop around for the rider's hands. The Stick: Ash pole, about 3 feet. Wool saddle blanket draped over it for grip. The Ride: Straddle the stick, grip the reins, and gallop. The head bobs with each stride.

assets.name: Frost Wyrm
assets.description: The Body: Serpentine form in ice-blue wool, about 24 inches long. Internal bone spine allows posing. The Scales: Overlapping leather strips on belly—natural brown against blue wool. The Head: Open maw with six bone fangs. Glacier-blue eyes. Menacing but huggable. The Wings: Vestigial leather wing stubs at shoulders—too small to fly, perfect for drama. The Claws: Four bone claws on small legs—positioned for gripping when wrapped around an arm. The Pose: Coil it, drape it, pose it to strike. The bone spine holds any position.

assets.name: Great North Sleigh
assets.description: The Runners: Bent ash with classic upturned fronts. Sealed smooth for gliding. The Frame: Oak cargo box painted crimson—the Gift-Bringer's signature color. The Finials: Antler points at front corners—a nod to the reindeer team. The Blanket: Crimson wool draped over the seat. Warm and festive. The Rope: Linen pull cord at front for towing across the snow. The Scale: About 12 inches long—perfect for doll passengers and tiny gift loads. The Glide: Actually slides on smooth surfaces. Load it up and pull.

assets.name: Storm-Wing Kite
assets.description: The Frame: Crossed birch sticks, pale wood against dark sail. Classic diamond kite shape. The Sail: Wool fabric stiffened with pine_tar smörring—black and gleaming, rigid as leather. The Bridle: Linen cord meeting at the kite's center of lift. Strong enough for winter gales. The Tail: Tow cord strips trailing behind—shaggy and wild, stabilizing in turbulence. In Flight: The black diamond against grey winter sky. It pulls hard in wind, alive on the line. The Scent: Pine tar and sheep—the smell of Nordic winters.

assets.name: Puppet Theater
assets.description: The Arch: Pine proscenium with carved knotwork. The stage window is about 12 inches wide. The Curtain: Crimson wool hanging from birch rod. Pulls aside dramatically for the show. The Back: Solid pine panel hides puppeteer hands. Cut-out at bottom for access. The Fold: Hinges flat for storage—takes up no more space than a book. The Scale: Table-top theater, about 18 inches tall. Perfect for finger puppets or stick figures. The Drama: Open curtain. Begin tale. The old stories live in the red-lit shadow.

assets.name: Stream Mill
assets.description: The Housing: Heavy oak block, hollowed inside. About 8 inches long, stable in stream current. The Wheel: Maple paddle wheel on one side—catches water flow or hand power. The Grinder: Maple disc spinning above bone plate. Narrow gap crushes whatever passes through. The Hopper: Birch bark cone funneling into the grinder gap from above. The Action: Water turns wheel, wheel turns grinder, hopper feeds berries, pulp exits below. The Lesson: Energy capture. Power transfer. The fundamental physics of the mill, toy-sized.

assets.name: Bergelmir's Ark
assets.description: The Hull: Coffin-boat shape (lúðr)—pine sides on oak keel. Seams black with pine_tar caulking. The Keel: Heavy oak provides ballast. The ark self-rights when tipped. The Sail: Square leather sail dyed blood-crimson. Rigged Nordic style. The Tar: Black seams where pine_tar caulks the joints—the 'blood-tight' seal. In Water: It floats, it sails, it carries small figures through the deluge. The Myth: Bergelmir's escape vessel, when Ymir's blood drowned the world.

assets.name: Treasure Chest
assets.description: The Box: Heavy oak chest, about 6 inches long. Grain matches between lid and body—proof of quality craft. The Hinges: Leather straps at back, stitched through wood. They flex but don't wear. The Closure: Front leather strap wraps around a bone toggle or wooden peg. The Interior: Soft linen lining cushions the treasures within. The Finish: Resin-sealed exterior gleams with amber warmth. Smooth to the touch. The Weight: Satisfyingly heavy. Oak doesn't make flimsy furniture.

assets.name: Yule Boar
assets.description: The Body: Stocky oak boar with carved bristle ridge along the back. Proud stance even on wheels. The Tusks: Curved bone tusks flanking the snout. The mark of Freyr's beast. The Eyes: Small fierce bone discs set in sockets. Watchful and wise. The Wheels: Four maple wheels on oak axles. The boar rolls smoothly after its owner. The Strap: Leather pull loop at neck. Drag the boar to the Yule feast. The Oath: In the old tradition, touch the boar's back when you make a promise. It still works.

assets.name: Nisse Boundary Levitator
assets.description: The Cart: Oak cargo box on four maple wheels. Heavy and stable, like a farm wagon. The Mast: Vertical oak pole rising from the cart center with cord channel at top. The Mechanism: Cord_drum on front axle—when wheels turn, drum winds the suspension cord. The Guardian: Light birch Nisse figure, arms outstretched, hanging from linen_cord. The Magic: Push the cart: Nisse rises. Pull back: Nisse descends. Always floating, never grounded. The Patrol: A child pulls the cart around the room's border. The Nisse watches over all.

assets.name: Dragon Scale Storm Slicks
assets.description: The Jacket: Knee-length juften leather coat with embossed dragon scales. Overlapping front panels shed rain. The Hat: Wide-brimmed rain hat, scales radiating from crown. Water runs off the back. The Boots: Ankle boots with fold-over cuff. Same scale pattern, same smoky black. The Texture: Each diamond scale stands in relief—run your fingers across and feel Nidhogg's hide. The Scent: Birch tar smoke—the unmistakable perfume of juften leather. The Promise: Stay dry in the storm. Look like a dragon doing it.

assets.name: Jormungandr Drift
assets.description: The Ocean: Heavy oak block painted deep blue with white wave crests. About 8 inches long. The Serpent: Birch Jormungandr head, jaws open, scales black with pine_tar. Emerges from slot in the waves. The Mechanism: Hidden below—traction roller on table, eccentric cam lifts serpent as you push. The Motion: Push forward: serpent rises through the waves. Pull back: it descends into the depths. The Silence: Wool washer dampens the cam. The rise is smooth and mysterious. The Myth: Jormungandr encircles Midgard. This toy shows his head breaking the surface.

assets.name: Ember Hauler
assets.description: The Bed: Pine cargo box with high sides. Open top for loading charcoal, ore, or toys. The Color: Ember orange coating—warm like dying coals, glowing in firelight. The Wheels: Four maple wheels on oak axles. They roll true and smooth. The Handle: Ash pull-stick at front. Flexible ash bends with the tug. The Undercarriage: Black pine_tar seals the bottom against wet and wear. The Cargo: Fill it with blocks, rocks, or pretend charcoal. The Svartálfar haul the dark harvest.

assets.name: Riding Horse
assets.description: The Frame: Hollow oak barrel body on maple curved runners. Rocks smoothly with gentle creak. The Head: Carved oak with alert ears, flared nostrils painted crimson, proud profile. The Mane: Wool yarn strands tied through drilled holes—flows with the rocking motion. The Saddle: Juften leather over wool blanket. Smoky black with the scent of birch tar. The Details: Crimson casein paint on eyes, nostrils, and harness trim. Leather reins and stirrup loops. The Ride: Sized for a toddler's first adventure. Rocks with satisfying weight and rhythm. The Legacy: Built to last generations. Your grandchildren will ride this horse.

assets.name: The Polar Express
assets.description: Locomotive: Jet black oak soaked in pine_tar until it looks like cast iron. The 'POLAR EXPRESS' lettering glows natural oak through the black—reverse stencil, no paint needed. Passenger Car: Midnight blue box with crimson window frames. Curved roof lifts off—inside: juften-black seats, bone figures. The Figures: Two bone children sit facing the windows. The antler conductor stands at the vestibule door, ticket punch raised forever. The Scent: Pine_tar and birch-smoke juften.

materials.category_style: Icon inventory style on clean parchment-colored background, item centered, no title banner, suitable for game crafting UI, clear silhouette

assets.name: Oak Log
assets.description: A freshly hewn oak log with rich honey-gold heartwood showing through the bark. Heavy and dense, with visible grain patterns running lengthwise.

assets.name: Ash Log
assets.description: A pale ash log with smooth grey bark. The wood is elastic and strong, prized for items that must bend without breaking.

assets.name: Birch Log
assets.description: A white birch log with distinctive papery bark marked with dark lenticels. The pale wood beneath is close-grained and workable.

assets.name: Pine Log
assets.description: A fragrant pine log with reddish bark and visible resin beads. Knotty and aromatic, the wood releases the scent of the northern forest.

assets.name: Maple Log
assets.description: A dense maple log with tight, swirling grain. The hardwood is prized for items requiring weight and durability.

assets.name: Raw Wool
assets.description: A bundle of raw sheep wool, creamy white with natural lanolin sheen. Soft and springy, ready for carding and spinning.

assets.name: Flax Bundle
assets.description: Dried flax stalks tied in a bundle. The golden stems contain strong fibers that will become linen thread.

assets.name: Raw Hide
assets.description: A stretched animal hide, pale and stiff. The surface shows the texture of the original skin, ready for tanning.

assets.name: Dried Sinew
assets.description: Bundles of dried animal sinew, pale and stringy. When wetted it becomes pliable; when dried it shrinks tight as iron.

assets.name: Bone Pieces
assets.description: Clean white bone pieces, smooth and chalky. The dense material takes carving well and polishes to a warm ivory sheen.

assets.name: Antler
assets.description: A shed deer antler with multiple tines. The surface is rough and textured, the core dense and workable.

assets.name: Rendered Tallow
assets.description: A block of rendered animal fat, creamy white and waxy. It melts smoothly and carries scents well.

assets.name: Pine Resin
assets.description: Amber lumps of hardened pine sap. Translucent and sticky when warmed, it smells of deep forest and seals wood against moisture.

assets.name: Birch Bark Sheets
assets.description: Peeled birch bark in thin, flexible sheets. The papery material is white with dark markings and naturally waterproof.

assets.name: Lye Crystals
assets.description: Coarse white crystals of wood ash lye in a ceramic pot. Caustic and powerful, used for bleaching and soap-making.

assets.name: Fresh Milk
assets.description: A wooden pail of fresh milk, creamy white with a thin layer of cream rising to the top.

assets.name: Birch Tar
assets.description: A pot of thick, dark birch tar. The viscous liquid gleams like black honey and smells of smoke and forest.

assets.name: Rowan Berries
assets.description: Clusters of bright red rowan berries on their stems. The vivid color stands out like drops of blood against the snow.

assets.name: Juniper Berries
assets.description: Small blue-black juniper berries with a dusty bloom. They smell sharp and clean, like mountain air.

assets.name: Lingonberries
assets.description: Tiny red lingonberries in a wooden bowl. Tart and bright, they gleam like scattered rubies.

assets.name: Pine Needles
assets.description: Fresh green pine needles bundled together. They release a sharp, resinous scent when crushed.

assets.name: Resin Seal
assets.description: A crafted component: Resin Seal. Made from pine_resin + tallow. Soft seal protects corners from chipping, safe for small hands

assets.name: Leather
assets.description: A crafted component: Leather. Made from hide + birch_bark + lye. Sturdy leather for scabbard covering and belt

assets.name: Wool Spool
assets.description: A crafted component: Wool Spool. Made from wool_fiber. Strong thread for stitching features and reinforcing stress points

assets.name: Wool Fabric
assets.description: A crafted component: Wool Fabric. Made from wool_spool (×3). Dense plain-weave fabric—sturdy shell that won't tear or pill

assets.name: Line Flax
assets.description: A crafted component: Line Flax. Made from scutched_flax. Metal teeth comb retted flax; long line_flax for thread, short tow for stuffing

assets.name: Tow
assets.description: A crafted component: Tow. Made from scutched_flax. Metal teeth comb retted flax; long line_flax for thread, short tow for stuffing

assets.name: Linen Cord
assets.description: A crafted component: Linen Cord. Made from line_flax. Strong twisted cord that won't snap under spinning tension

assets.name: Crimson Pigment
assets.description: A crafted component: Crimson Pigment. Made from lingonberry. Blood red from lingonberry

assets.name: Quark Curds
assets.description: A crafted component: Quark Curds. Made from milk + wood_vinegar. Casein preparation

assets.name: Liquid Whey
assets.description: A crafted component: Liquid Whey. Made from milk + wood_vinegar. Casein preparation

assets.name: Cheese Glue
assets.description: A crafted component: Cheese Glue. Made from quark_curds + lye. Beina-mjólk binder for durable paint

assets.name: Blue Pigment
assets.description: A crafted component: Blue Pigment. Made from juniper_berry. Cool blue from juniper—the shimmer between the flames

assets.name: Bone Eyes
assets.description: A crafted component: Bone Eyes. Made from bone. Polished bone discs with carved pupils

assets.name: Orange Pigment
assets.description: A crafted component: Orange Pigment. Made from rowan_berry. Rowan berries grind to a warm orange powder—the Nisse's favorite color

assets.name: Bone Toggle
assets.description: A crafted component: Bone Toggle. Made from bone. Internal anchors sewn into ear bases—allows ears to pose and hold position

assets.name: Bone Button
assets.description: A crafted component: Bone Button. Made from bone. Decorative nose button

assets.name: Leather Strap
assets.description: A crafted component: Leather Strap. Made from leather. Hand grip on back

assets.name: Board (Pine)
assets.description: A crafted component: Board (Pine). Made from log (pine). Light pine for portable theater

assets.name: Board (Oak)
assets.description: A crafted component: Board (Oak). Made from log (oak). Heavy oak boards for a chest that lasts generations

assets.name: Linen Spool
assets.description: A crafted component: Linen Spool. Made from line_flax. Fine linen thread—stronger than wool, smoother to the touch

assets.name: Linen Fabric
assets.description: A crafted component: Linen Fabric. Made from linen_spool (×3). Plain weave linen—cool, crisp, durable

assets.name: Hide Glue
assets.description: A crafted component: Hide Glue. Made from hide + sinew. Gård-Lím: the binder that makes distemper paint

assets.name: Crimson Casein
assets.description: A crafted component: Crimson Casein. Made from crimson_pigment + cheese_glue. Water-resistant crimson paint for the sail

assets.name: Wheel
assets.description: A crafted component: Wheel. Made from log (maple). Smooth maple wheels for rolling

assets.name: Juften Leather
assets.description: A crafted component: Juften Leather. Made from leather + birch_tar + tallow. Smoky black waterproof leather, supple and breathable

assets.name: Orange Tallow Raw
assets.description: A crafted component: Orange Tallow Raw. Made from orange_pigment + tallow. Vibrant tallow paint that soaks into carved grooves

assets.name: Blue Tallow Raw
assets.description: A crafted component: Blue Tallow Raw. Made from blue_pigment + tallow. Aurora shimmer paint—blended into orange edges

assets.name: Drum Skin
assets.description: A crafted component: Drum Skin. Made from leather. Circular head stretched over frame

assets.name: Horse Head
assets.description: A crafted component: Horse Head. Made from log (ash). Stylized head with open mouth—ash is light but strong

assets.name: Crimson Tallow Raw
assets.description: A crafted component: Crimson Tallow Raw. Made from crimson_pigment + tallow. Crimson paint for frame

assets.name: Axle Set
assets.description: A crafted component: Axle Set. Made from wheel (×4) + stick (oak) (×2). Front and rear axles pinned to body

assets.name: Set Of Blocks
assets.description: A crafted component: Set Of Blocks. Made from log (oak). Höggva: We hew the oak log down to three identical cubes using axe, measuring by eye and hand-span.

assets.name: Squared Rod
assets.description: A crafted component: Squared Rod. Made from log (ash). Höggva: Split and square the ash log in one action. The grain must run continuous—a sawn rod will snap under bending, but a hewn billet will yield to the sun's curve.

assets.name: Supple Rod
assets.description: A crafted component: Supple Rod. Made from squared_rod. Boil the rod in water until the lignin softens. We seethe the wood until it yields like wet leather in the hands.

assets.name: Ash Hoop
assets.description: A crafted component: Ash Hoop. Made from supple_rod. Sveigja: Pin the hot rod into a circular frame while steam still rises. Force it into its 'memory' before it cools.

assets.name: Guide Stick
assets.description: A crafted component: Guide Stick. Made from stick (birch). Sníða: Carve the birch to a squared grip that won't slip in a frozen mitten, leaving the natural Y-fork at the tip to cradle the hoop.

assets.name: Wreath Base
assets.description: A crafted component: Wreath Base. Made from branch (birch) (×3). Flétta: Braid three green birch wands together while the sap is alive. A single bent branch is weak, but a trinity of braided birch creates a circle that will never lose its heart.

assets.name: Top Rough Out
assets.description: A crafted component: Top Rough Out. Made from log (maple). Höggva: Hew the dense maple log into a rough octagonal blank on the Höggvabekkr. The mass is there—the body shape with its stem socket waiting to be turned.

assets.name: Top Carved
assets.description: A crafted component: Top Carved. Made from top_rough_out. Renna: Shape the spinning blank on the pole lathe (Rennubekkr) at the Snikkarabekkr. Wide at equator, tapered to needle-point, with the stem socket carved at crown.

assets.name: Top Bleached
assets.description: A crafted component: Top Bleached. Made from top_carved + lye + milk. Hvíta: Submerge the wood in the Ketill to bleach it white. We use the action of Sjóða (seething) to drive the milk into the grain.

assets.name: Swan Family Rough Outs
assets.description: A crafted component: Swan Family Rough Outs. Made from log (pine). Höggva: Hew the pine log into blocky rough-outs—one mother swan shape, three cygnet masses. The skíð still holds the bark but shows the forms waiting within.

assets.name: Swan Family Carved
assets.description: A crafted component: Swan Family Carved. Made from swan_family_rough_outs. Sníða: On the shaving horse, pull the drawknife to release the graceful curves. The mother's arched neck, the cygnets' teardrop bodies—pine yields easily to the blade.

assets.name: Swan Family Bleached
assets.description: A crafted component: Swan Family Bleached. Made from swan_family_carved + lye + milk. Hvíta: Submerge the carved swans in lye and milk. The alkaline solution bleaches pine to frost-white while milk proteins soften the grain for a matte finish.

assets.name: Tuned Bars
assets.description: A crafted component: Tuned Bars. Made from log (birch). Birch is a resonant tonewood; five bars carved to graduated lengths, notched underneath to tune each pitch

assets.name: Sound Box
assets.description: A crafted component: Sound Box. Made from log (pine). Pine rived into a shallow trough—the hollow amplifies and warms the tone

assets.name: Lye Soap
assets.description: A crafted component: Lye Soap. Made from lye + tallow. Thin coating seals the bars without dampening vibration

assets.name: Pedestal Blank
assets.description: A crafted component: Pedestal Blank. Made from log (oak). Höggva: On the Höggvabekkr, rive the oak to find the straight heart-grain and hew it into a heavy, squared block. This ensures the base will never crack from the candle's heat.

assets.name: Oak Pedestal
assets.description: A crafted component: Oak Pedestal. Made from pedestal_blank. Sníða: At the Snikkarabekkr, carve the deep socket to hold the tallow and a wide, steady foot. Etch a shallow groove at the base to cradle the vow-scroll.

assets.name: Wick Line
assets.description: A crafted component: Wick Line. Made from branch (birch). Sníða: Carefully peel the inner bast fibers from the birch. Twist these into a tight cord and press them on the bench; this organic line drinks the fat better than any sinew.

assets.name: Etched Vow Scroll
assets.description: A crafted component: Etched Vow Scroll. Made from birch_bark. Grafning: Score the ancient vow into the silver skin of the Björk: 'At the darkest time, bring light.' The bark preserves the oath even as the candle burns.

assets.name: Cleansing Dust
assets.description: A crafted component: Cleansing Dust. Made from juniper_berry. Mala: Grind the blue berries in the Mylna to a fine powder. This dust purifies the hall and fills the air with the scent of the high mountains.

assets.name: Scented Fat
assets.description: A crafted component: Scented Fat. Made from tallow + cleansing_dust. Sjóða: Seethe the tallow in the Ketill and fold in the juniper dust. The heat marries the mountain scent to the fat, creating a slow-burning incense.

assets.name: Orange Soap
assets.description: A crafted component: Orange Soap. Made from orange_pigment + tallow + lye. Cheerful orange soap, fragrant and festive. A small luxury.

assets.name: Small Basket
